scope: Documented matrices, not the full Cartesian product. Case totals include overlap between matrices. Repairs reran affected subsets; superseded failures are not counted as final passes.

automated.cropRule: 256 px transparent foreground; flag >8 pixels with alpha >180 outside radius 127 around (128,128).

matrices.definition: 36 bodies + 128 other source assets × 4 shapes × 9 skins
14 eyes × 8 brows (including none) × 12 mouths; shapes/skins distributed
6 hair choices × 7 neckwear choices × 4 shapes × 12 mouths
20 hats × 6 extras × 4 shapes; halo and flower subsets supersede earlier cells
15 held objects × 4 shapes × 11 gestures; wrench and salute subsets supersede earlier cells
80 salute/hat + 32 text boundary + 28 sticker-count + 40 preset + 112 seeded random outfit cases

visualReview.method: AI visual inspection of circular contact sheets; targeted repairs reviewed again. Automated success was not used as visual approval.
visualReview.result: Accepted within the recorded review scope
visualReview.reproduce: Run scripts/audit-project.mjs in every listed mode; PNG review sheets and report.json are generated in the requested directory.

checks: All five tabs render their option thumbnails without failed images.
Keyboard tabs, selected states, focus and skip link preserve the avatar.
Text normalization, copied share URL and reload reproduce the exact canvas.
Crop toggle, reset and Surprise me update the real preview.
Laptop sticker limit permits six selections and rejects a seventh.
390 px light/dark layouts: no horizontal overflow; all visible buttons meet 44 × 44 px.
Failed body request shows retry; retry recovers after the connection is restored.
Fitting tool includes empty holding hand, guards invalid scale input and fits its mobile controls without overflow.
Editor and fitting tool make no third-party requests.

limits: Chromium in a Linux managed environment; physical Safari/iOS and Android not verified.
Manual VoiceOver/NVDA and Lighthouse audits remain open.
2D compositing approximates contact shading and material matching; this is not a 3D model or a guarantee for every possible outfit.
Review-sheet PNGs are reproducible outputs and are not all included in the repository; hashes identify the reviewed local outputs.
